facebook:pages_manage_posts.grants: create, edit and delete posts on the Pages the person manages
facebook:pages_manage_posts.note: `FacebookApiClient` publishes to `/{pageId}/feed` and replies to comments through `/{commentId}/comments`.

facebook:pages_read_engagement.grants: read the content, comments, insights and engagement of the Pages the person manages
facebook:pages_read_engagement.note: `FacebookApiClient` reads Page insights, post comments and the Page's details for analytics and mentions.

facebook:pages_show_list.grants: list the Pages the person manages
facebook:pages_show_list.note: The Facebook connect step requests it because Meta makes it a prerequisite of `pages_manage_posts`; no adapter declares it and no scanned code lists Pages.

hubspot:crm.objects.contacts.write.grants: create, update and delete the portal's contacts
hubspot:crm.objects.contacts.write.note: Requested by the HubSpot authorize route, but `HubSpotAdapter` never writes a contact.

hubspot:timeline.grants: create timeline events on CRM records
hubspot:timeline.note: `HubSpotAdapter.logActivity` posts to `/crm/v3/timeline/events` to log OmniPost activity.

instagram:instagram_basic.grants: read the professional account's profile and media
instagram:instagram_basic.note: `InstagramApiClient` reads the account's media list and media objects on `graph.facebook.com`.

instagram:instagram_content_publish.grants: publish media to the professional account
instagram:instagram_content_publish.note: `InstagramApiClient` publishes through `/{userId}/media` and `/{userId}/media_publish`, yet the Instagram connect step never requests it.

instagram:pages_read_engagement.grants: read the content and engagement of the Facebook Pages the person manages
instagram:pages_read_engagement.note: Listed only by the shared metadata for Instagram; the Instagram connect step does not request it and no Instagram code path reads a Page.

instagram:user_media.grants: read the account's media (Basic Display API)
instagram:user_media.note: Requested by the Instagram connect step, but no scanned code reads media with the Basic Display token; `InstagramApiClient` reads media through the Graph API instead.

instagram:user_profile.grants: read the account's id, username, account type and media count (Basic Display API)
instagram:user_profile.note: The Instagram connect step reads `graph.instagram.com/me?fields=id,username,media_count,account_type` with it; it belongs to the Basic Display API, which Meta retired, and no adapter declares it.

linkedin:openid.grants: authenticate the member through OpenID Connect
linkedin:openid.note: The LinkedIn connect step reads `/v2/userinfo`, which needs it.

linkedin:profile.grants: read the member's name and picture
linkedin:profile.note: The LinkedIn connect step reads the member's name and picture from `/v2/userinfo`.

linkedin:w_member_social.grants: create, edit and delete posts and comments on the member's behalf
linkedin:w_member_social.note: `LinkedInApiClient` publishes posts and comments with the member URN as author.

linkedin:w_organization_social.grants: create, edit and delete posts and comments for an organization the member administers
linkedin:w_organization_social.note: `LinkedInApiClient` acts as the organization only when the channel's credentials carry an `organizationUrn`; the LinkedIn connect step never requests it.

pinterest:boards:read.grants: read the account's public boards and their pins
pinterest:boards:read.note: `PinterestApiClient.createPin` creates a Pin on a board, and Pinterest needs this scope to read that board.

pinterest:boards:write.grants: create, update and delete the account's public boards
pinterest:boards:write.note: `PinterestApiClient.createBoard` exists, but no adapter or route calls it; the shared metadata does not list it.

pinterest:pins:read.grants: read the account's public pins and their analytics

pinterest:pins:write.grants: create, update and delete the account's public pins

pinterest:user_accounts:read.grants: read the account's profile and account information
pinterest:user_accounts:read.note: The Pinterest connect step reads `/v5/user_account` and `PinterestAdapter` validates credentials through it, yet the connect step does not request this scope.

salesforce:api.grants: access the org's data through the REST API
salesforce:api.note: `SalesforceAdapter` reads contacts by SOQL and creates `Task` records to log OmniPost activity.

salesforce:refresh_token.grants: receive a refresh token for offline access
salesforce:refresh_token.note: `SalesforceAdapter.refreshAccessToken` renews the access token with the refresh token this scope yields.

snapchat:snapchat-marketing-api.grants: use the Marketing API, including the member's profile and email
snapchat:snapchat-marketing-api.note: The Snapchat connect step reads `adsapi.snapchat.com/v1/me`, email included, and `SnapchatApiClient` uploads story media on the same API.

snapchat:snapchat-profile-api.grants: manage the account's Public Profile and its stories
snapchat:snapchat-profile-api.note: `SnapchatAdapter` declares it, but every scanned Snapchat call goes to the Marketing API (`adsapi.snapchat.com`) and no connect step requests it.

threads:threads_basic.grants: read the account's profile and posts
threads:threads_basic.note: `ThreadsAdapter` reads the account's posts; the Threads login entry is a stub, so no connect step requests it.

threads:threads_content_publish.grants: publish posts and replies to the account
threads:threads_content_publish.note: `ThreadsAdapter` publishes posts and replies; the Threads login entry is a stub, so no connect step requests it.

threads:threads_manage_replies.grants: reply to, hide and manage replies on the account's posts
threads:threads_manage_replies.note: `ThreadsAdapter` declares it for its replies capability and posts replies with `reply_to_id`; only the adapter declares it.

threads:threads_read_replies.grants: read replies to and by the account
threads:threads_read_replies.note: `ThreadsAdapter` reads `/{userId}/replies` for its replies capability; only the adapter declares it.

tiktok:user.info.basic.grants: read the account's open id, avatar and display name
tiktok:user.info.basic.note: The TikTok connect step reads `/v2/user/info/` with it; the shared metadata does not list it.

tiktok:video.publish.grants: post content directly to the account
tiktok:video.publish.note: `TikTokApiClient` posts videos through `/post/publish/video/init/`, which TikTok gates behind this scope; only the shared metadata lists it, and the TikTok connect step never requests it.

tiktok:video.upload.grants: upload content to the account as a draft the user posts in TikTok
tiktok:video.upload.note: Requested by the TikTok connect step; `TikTokApiClient` posts photos through `/post/publish/content/init/`, which TikTok accepts under this scope or `video.publish`.

x:offline.access.grants: receive a refresh token, so access outlives the access token
x:offline.access.note: The X connect step stores the `refresh_token` the token exchange returns, which X issues only under this scope; adapters never request tokens, so none declares it.

x:tweet.read.grants: read posts, including public replies and mentions
x:tweet.read.note: `XApiClient` reads post metrics for analytics and searches recent posts for replies and brand mentions.

x:tweet.write.grants: publish posts on the account's behalf
x:tweet.write.note: `XAdapter` publishes posts, threads, replies, polls and quote posts through `XApiClient`.

x:users.read.grants: read the account's profile and other users' public profiles
x:users.read.note: The X connect step reads `/2/users/me` with it, and `XApiClient.validateCredentials` calls the same endpoint.

youtube:https://www.googleapis.com/auth/.grants: manage the YouTube account: videos, playlists, comments and channel settings
youtube:https://www.googleapis.com/auth/.note: Listed only by the shared metadata; the YouTube connect step does not request it, so no token carries it.

youtube:https://www.googleapis.com/auth/.grants: read the channel, its videos and its playlists
youtube:https://www.googleapis.com/auth/.note: The YouTube connect step reads `channels?part=snippet&mine=true` with it; the same grant as the adapter's `youtube.readonly`, spelled as the Google scope string.
Requested by the YouTube connect step and listed by the shared metadata; the same grant as the adapter's `youtube.upload`, spelled as the Google scope string.

youtube:youtube.readonly.grants: read the channel, its videos and its playlists
youtube:youtube.readonly.note: `YouTubeAdapter` declares it for channel and video reads; the same grant as the connect step's `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.readonly`, and the short name is not a Google scope string.

youtube:youtube.upload.note: `YouTubeAdapter` declares it for video upload; the same grant as the connect step's `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.upload`, and the short name is not a Google scope string.
